mechanism: Bumetanide-induced hypokalemia and dehydration may potentiate gabapentin neurotoxicity; gabapentin is renally eliminated and loop diuretics may impair renal function, increasing gabapentin accumulation.
action: Monitor renal function, electrolytes (particularly potassium), and gabapentin tolerability; adjust gabapentin dosing based on creatinine clearance; ensure adequate hydration and consider potassium supplementation if needed.
